en.headline: Customs seize 8000kg unmanifested tobacco at Shenzhen Bay
en.dek: Officers stopped a medium goods vehicle claiming to carry plastic wood flooring and found about 300 boxes of duty-unpaid manufactured tobacco with an estimated market value of HK$53.4 million.
body: Hong Kong Customs said officers intercepted an inbound medium goods vehicle at Shenzhen Bay Control Point on Monday after intelligence analysis.

The vehicle was declared as carrying plastic wood flooring. Inspection revealed about 300 boxes of unmanifested and duty-unpaid manufactured tobacco weighing about 8000 kilograms, with no declared cargo present.
A 51-year-old local male driver was arrested. The estimated market value of the tobacco is about HK$53.4 million and the duty potential about HK$32.04 million.

The investigation continues. Customs is tracing the source and destination of the consignment and does not rule out further arrests. Smuggling unmanifested goods can attract a maximum fine of HK$2 million and seven years' imprisonment under the Import and Export Ordinance.

zh.headline: 海關深圳灣檢獲約8000公斤未完稅煙草 拘司機
zh.dek: 人員截查報稱載有塑木地板的中型貨車，發現約300箱未列艙單及未完稅製成煙草，估計市值約5340萬元，51歲本地男司機被捕。
body: 香港海關表示，人員根據情報分析，周一在深圳灣管制站截查一輚入境中型貨車。
貨車報稱載有塑木地板，檢查後發現約300箱未列艙單及未完稅製成煙草，重量約8000公斤，並無任何已申報貨物。
51歲本地男司機被捕。涉案煙草估計市值約5340萬元，應課稅值約3204萬元。
案件仍在調查，海關正追查來源及去向，不排除有更多人被捕。根據《進出口條例》，輸入未列艙單貨物一經定罪最高可罰款200萬元及監禁七年。
